title: AP2 failure: invalid_credential on a broken mandate chain
summary: The Credential Provider rejects a Payment Mandate chain whose closed mandate is not signed by the key in cnf or whose sd_hash does not match. The error is terminal and no token is issued.

steps.label: Present open and closed Payment Mandates
steps.detail: A compromised or buggy agent presents a closed mandate signed with a key other than the one in the open mandate's cnf, or edits a disclosure so that sd_hash no longer matches.

steps.label: Verify the chain under Delegate SD-JWT
steps.detail: The key-binding signature does not verify against cnf, so the chain fails before any constraint is read.

failures.condition: The chain verifies but the closed mandate changes a value the open mandate fixed, such as the payee
failures.outcome: invalid_mandate: the mandate does not approve this action; terminal.

steps.label: Payment Receipt: status Error, invalid_credential
steps.detail: A terminal error: no token is issued. The schema requires payment_id even on error, so the example carries a placeholder.

payload.content:
# Illustrative example, spec version v0.2. Decoded view; hashes and signatures shortened.
# Payment Receipt JWT payload with a terminal error (payment_receipt.json).
{
  "status": "Error",
  "iss": "https://wallet.example",
  "iat": 1791760200,
  "reference": "k9Pq...hash-of-presented-mandate",
  "payment_id": "pay_none",
  "error": "invalid_credential",
  "error_description": "Closed mandate is not signed by the key in cnf."
}

steps.label: Record the rejection
steps.detail: With an error receipt in hand the agent may present a different, correct mandate. The protocol defines no retry counter.
